purpose: Preview-only gate for deciding whether the current Vanadium convention evidence can authorize a raw McMillan row patch.

unsupported_older_preview.note: This preview is retained as historical sensitivity context only; current source captures do not support it.

mcmillan_preview_cases.interpretation: Current raw row remains a severe overprediction.
Primary Tc/Theta alone does not rescue the row.
Using the captured lambda while retaining working mu_star worsens the overprediction.
The lower captured mu_star convention still leaves the row far outside the 20 percent gate.
The primary captured mu_star convention improves the row versus the current row but still fails badly.
This is near the per-row threshold, but it is not source-supported by the current Vanadium evidence captures.

projected_topic_average_if_single_vanadi.interpretation: Even the best source-backed Vanadium convention preview does not make the raw McMillan topic gate close to PASS. The unsupported older preview would improve the average more, but cannot be used as a row patch.

why_not_patch: The source-backed Vanadium coupling/mu-star combinations remain far outside the per-row 20 percent raw McMillan gate.
The only near-threshold preview uses lambda_ep=0.6, which is not supported by the current Vanadium source captures.
The captured lambda and mu_star values come from an Eliashberg/full-text context and still need formula-family convention review before benchmark-row use.
decision.next_controller: Decide whether Vanadium should stay in the raw McMillan gate as a documented row-source/model-family failure, move to an Eliashberg/Allen-Dynes-compatible branch, or be excluded from the raw McMillan benchmark with an explicit source-backed rationale.

claim_boundary: This gate is a convention-impact preview only. It does not authorize editing real_superconductor_data.json and does not reduce the primary raw McMillan FAIL.
